title: 1920–1921年衰退
one_line: 一战后美国及多国的急剧通缩型经济衰退（1920–1921）。
overview: The Recession of 1920–1921 was a sharp deflationary economic contraction in the United States, United Kingdom and other countries, beginning 14 months after the end of World War I. It lasted from January 1920 to July 1921. The extent of the deflation was not only large, but large relative to the accompanying decline in real product.（据维基摘要；完整时间线/数据待核实补充。）

causal_chain.step: 一战结束后14个月、战时需求与财政货币扩张退潮 → 需求与物价回落
1920年1月—1921年7月的急剧通缩型收缩（美英等国）
通缩幅度相对实际产出降幅异常大
